# <span id="aanchor329"></span> Service Configuration

Use the Service Configuration screen to set up FLOWCAL services that you installed on the application server(s). Available options vary based on the modules you purchased.

Before you begin service configuration, you must create a FLOWCAL service account within the application. Most companies create a user name called "FCSRV" to easily identify it. The service account should be an administrator account with permissions.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Service Configuration screen:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  In the **Services** group, select **Service Configuration**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 561;height: 472;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Service Login">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Service Login</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Service Login">

All services use the same user name, password, and database information. To specify these credentials, you must be on the server where you installed the services. FLOWCAL writes the information to the registry, so it must be encrypted on the server where the services will run.

If you update the service login information, you must restart the services.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Text File Imports">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Text File Imports</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Text File Imports">

The following options are available for importing text files for meters and sources:

- **Auto Create** - Select this option to create a new source analysis or meter number for any unidentified source analysis or meter number found in the text file and import the data. If you do not select this option, FLOWCAL discards the unidentified data.
- **Use Field As Import ID** - Select this option to automatically select the **Source Analysis number field is Import ID** or **Meter number field is Import ID** option during manual imports of source analysis or meter text files. If FLOWCAL finds a match, it imports the data into the corresponding source analysis or meter. If FLOWCAL does not find a match, it does not import the data.
- **Neither** - Select this option if you do not want to store imported data for meters and source analyses if the meter or source does not exist in the database, and you do not want to store the data under any alternate ID.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Transaction Queue Options">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Transaction Queue Options</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Transaction Queue Options">

The following options are available for transaction queue processing:

- **Auto Create Meters** - Select this option to automatically create meters during transaction queue processing if they do not already exist and the transaction queue receives data for them. If you do not select this option, FLOWCAL discards the data.
- **Auto Create Sources** - Select this option to automatically create sources during transaction queue processing if they do not already exist and the transaction queue receives data for them. If you do not select this option, FLOWCAL discards the data.
- **Check Meter Import ID First** - Select this option if you want FLOWCAL to attempt to correlate the meter number field from the Transaction Queue table to the **Meter Import ID** field first. If FLOWCAL finds a match, it imports the data into the corresponding meter. If FLOWCAL does not find a match, it uses the meter number field to correlate the data.
- **Check Source Import ID First** - Select this option if you want FLOWCAL to attempt to correlate the source number field from the Transaction Queue table to the **Source Import ID** field first. If FLOWCAL finds a match, it imports the data into the corresponding source. If FLOWCAL does not find a match, it uses the source number field to correlate the data.
- **Allow Duplicate Source Import IDs** - Select this option to allow the same source quality to be imported to multiple sources per the defined Import ID.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Service Installations">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Service Installations</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Service Installations">

The following fields specify information for installing services:

- **Service Count** - The number of instances of a service to run. FLOWCAL uses this information to divide the work across multiple services. Specify the maximum number you plan to run for any given service. For example, if you have two instances of the Meter Rollup service, two instances of the Location Rollup service, and only one instance of the other services, specify "2."
- **Services Host Computer** - The default server name that the Service Monitor will use.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Services">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Services</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Services">

The following options are available for configuring FLOWCAL services:

- **Interval** - The length of time for which the service will sleep before running again. If you leave this value as 0, the service will sleep for one minute. This allows multiple services to share the CPU.

  The interval value for the Live Oil service will default to 10 minutes when set to 0.

- **Port** - The port that the Service Monitor uses to communicate with the service. This should be unique for every service. When running multiple copies of a service, such as FcSrvMtrRollup and FcSrvMtrRollup2, the second service will use a port one increment larger than the one shown on the editor.

- **Include `n` prior months** - The number of prior months that FLOWCAL should examine for audits (Audit service only).

- **Include `n` prior days** - The number of prior days that FLOWCAL should examine when calculating liquid component line fill (LineFill service only).

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Roll Options">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Roll Options</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Roll Options">

Use these options to limit how far back in time FLOWCAL queues rollups for meters, calculated meters, and locations. Limiting the amount of time eliminates unnecessary data from the rollup process.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="File Imports tab">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />File Imports Tab</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="File Imports tab">

Use the **File Imports** tab to configure the following settings for the File Import service:

- **Folder to Check** - The directory from which the service imports files.
- **After every run pause for `n` sec.** - The time interval at which FLOWCAL polls the directory for new information to process. If you do not specify a value, FLOWCAL polls the directory every 60 seconds.
- **Log Processed Files** - Select this option if you want the File Import service to generate a log file entry for every file that it processes. This is useful when researching issues with file imports. If you are not researching an issue, enabling this option is not recommended as the log file grows rapidly.
- **Port Number** - The port that the Service Monitor uses to communicate with the service. This will be unique for every service. When running multiple copies of a service, the second service will use a port one increment larger than the one shown in the editor.
- **Number of Retries** - The number of additional attempts that will be tried if the file fails to import on the first attempt.

Windows has a hard-coded limit of 260 characters for file paths; file paths longer than this will not work. Importing files from a local install allows for using drive letters for network file paths; however, Citrix resolves the actual network location, which can cause the number of characters in a file path to exceed this limit.

</div>
